answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each identity locks 12 tokens; rewards unlock only after 20 epochs of a fingerprint — timing jitter, task mix, rhythm. A farm betrays itself: a thousand identities share one operator's rhythm, planted like an orchard, and a whisper of gaps exposes the grove. Faking 1,000 fingerprints locks 12,000 tokens for 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays 12 once, its reward river flowing. Cluster detection slashes escrow.
